banks.line: Left them standing on the banks
stanza: I left my mother
I left my father
Left my sisters too
Left them standing on the banks
And they pulled me out
Of this mighty mighty river
I am a rock
Bottom riser
And I owe it all to you

banks.line: When I'm smilin', it's her and the banks
stanza: And her love makes me feel like I'm home
Keeps me good comp'ny wherever I go
When I'm smilin', it's her and the banks
The Big Sandy River that colors my face

blanks.line: Same old cut and pasting, just fill in the blanks
stanza: Now it's gone, blown on a lonely wind of change
Now I feel like I miss it most
Just 'cause I never thought that it could change
So I hear things are moving west these days
Same old cut and pasting, just fill in the blanks
Standing here right now, though it brings a lot of pain
I smile when I think of yesterday

blanks.line: It'd been so long, it'd been so long, my mind filled in the blanks
stanza: I dreamt we spoke, I dreamt we spoke again
It'd been so long, it'd been so long, my mind filled in the blanks
I dreamt we spoke, I dreamt we spoke again
It'd been so long, it'd been so long, your voice was like a ghost

thanks.line: And now it don't feel like the world's on my shoulders (Thanks)
stanza: And now it don't feel like the world's on my shoulders (Thanks)
Everyone's leanin' on me
'Cause my baby knows that her daddy's a soldier
Nothin' can take her from me

thanks.line: Give Jah the thanks, the thanks, the thanks
thanks.lineNext: The thanks, the thanks, the thanks

stanza: Thank you so much for having me
Thanks

tanks.line: Secrets leaking from the gas tanks
stanza: In the window of the storefront
There's a mugshot for a manhunt
And those cakes all decorated with cartoons
Piñatas shaped like parrots
Secrets leaking from the gas tanks
In the back, while they were twisting up balloons
